prompt:

Do NOT reinterpret view names or replace thin edge views with full shields. Keep empty row2 col3 and row4 col3 transparent.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: paint ONLY existing grey shapes as unlit base colour of source-faithful upright point-down Kira's Shield. Match blue-grey worn metal face, broad weathered silver steel rim with subdued warm wear, and central dark rune from reference. Scale details to the existing views; preserve geometry exactly. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, halo, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text. Reference highlight is not to be copied as lighting.

Preserve full transparency outside and all gaps. Paint grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.
Strict silhouette correction: output clean, solid silhouettes matching the original grey guide exactly, with completely transparent pixels everywhere else. No scattered pixels, speckling, red flecks, ragged overspray or fragmented edges around any object. Lower-half masks must be uniform pure #FF0000 without any texture or tonal variation. Preserve original polygonal outline of the full shield, not a newly rounded outline. Use original guide as the exact shape stencil.
validation: Layout retained; stray pixels and mask colour variation remain after the permitted corrective generation. Raw output preserved without postprocessing.
